Do not disclose a diagnosis, student records, or personal contact details. A private accessible reporting route must be configured before open release; current course support should use the instructor's established channel.

## Task and version

Module/link, commit/release, task attempted, and expected result.

## Barrier

Give reproducible steps and the observed barrier. Include OS/browser/assistive-technology versions only if comfortable and relevant. A screenshot is never required.

## Impact and alternative

Does this block core learning? Is another route effective for the same outcome? Maintainers should record a repair owner and retest evidence.
